newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Kare has Porgera potential - Carpenter.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Kare has Porgera potential - Carpenter.

text.p: Carpenter Pacific NL said on Wednesday the Mount Kare gold prospect in Papua New Guinea has the potential to match the nearby Porgera gold project.
"We feel that Mt Kare has the potential to equal that (Porgera) in the long term," said Richard Newport, Carpenter Pacific's consulting geologist.
Newport told a media briefing that Porgera had 11.1 million ounces of gold left in its deposit and had produced about seven million ounces since it started production.
Mt Kare is about 17 km southwest of the Porgera project in the central highlands of Papua New Guinea.
